obligations.source_text: Create a vertical photorealistic fine-art fashion portrait on a luminous blue shoreline at low tide. One unmistakably adult woman in her mid-twenties steps through clear ankle-deep water while steadying the brim of her natural woven straw hat. She wears an airy ankle-length white linen sundress and carries a small warm smile. The photographed world obeys one precise impossible rule: one invisible spatial coordinate law fractures the scene into three depth-aware parallel displacement bands. The face is the largest and strongest convergence point. A bold central band crosses her eyes, nose, and smile, while each displaced facial fragment retains complete eye, nose, mouth, skin, and lighting coherence. Each band shifts every intersected surface by the same exact lateral distance. The same offset continues through her hat brim, hair, wet-sand reflection, dress folds, waterline, and distant horizon. Along the fault edges, fine square spatial particles expose the displaced blue sea behind them, obeying the same spacing and direction. Their depth-correct parallax and occlusion establish the bands inside photographed space. Unaffected anatomy, fabric, perspective, sunlight, sand, and water remain physically coherent. Natural lens and sensor response remain optically clean. Three matched displacement bands make one deliberate coordinate-system failure unmistakable from the photograph alone. Serene coastal beauty dominates the first glance; the impossible facial rupture becomes compelling and uncanny on the second.
